problem_statement: When the DNS resolver is configured to query all available servers, a DNS name query must be sent to every configured DNS server, and the first valid response received is the one returned to the application (no further response must trigger additional callbacks). Currently a query is only sent to the first available server. With the new configuration option enabled, a query must reach all configured servers while still producing a single resolved result.

verification.reason: The statement adequately describes the required behaviour (query all servers, first response wins, no extra callbacks) but omits the exact Kconfig option name that the tests and testcase.yaml reference. Adding that name makes the task solvable.

problems.detail: The statement refers to 'the new configuration option' but never gives its exact name. The hidden tests and testcase.yaml use CONFIG_DNS_RESOLVER_QUERY_ALL_AVAILABLE_SERVERS, which an agent cannot guess from the description alone.

problem_statement_fixed: When the DNS resolver is configured to query all available servers, a DNS name query must be sent to every configured DNS server, and the first valid response received is the one returned to the application (no further response must trigger additional callbacks). Currently a query is only sent to the first available server. With the new configuration option CONFIG_DNS_RESOLVER_QUERY_ALL_AVAILABLE_SERVERS enabled, a query must reach all configured servers while still producing a single resolved result. When this option is disabled (the default), behaviour must remain unchanged: queries are sent only to the first available server.
